newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Glaxo up as Govett upgrades.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Glaxo up as Govett upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc climbed on Wednesday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett upgraded their recommendation on the pharmaceutical group to "buy" from "undervalued", with a buying target of 12.63 stg.
The shares were 19p firmer at 10.96 stg by 1010 GMT.

"We have valued Glaxo on underlying growth, excluding Zantac, given it an international peer group value comparison, and then added to that Zantac's business stripped out and just run for cash until 2001," said one of the analysts in ABN AMRO Hoare Govett's pharmaceuticals team.
"On fairly conservative assumptions, you get a current buying target of 12.63 stg," he said. "It's more than underpinned by the fundamantals, with good news flow coming out this year."
